findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 法律程序章節僅述例行智財與一般商業訴訟，未列政府反壟斷調查；風險因素提及 FTC 與州檢察長對隱私的審查加強。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: From time to time, we are involved in various legal proceedings, disputes, and other claims arising in the ordinary course of business, including employment, intellectual property, product liability, and breach of contract claims.

findings.claim: Quince 於 2026-02 對 Deckers 提起反壟斷訴訟，指稱以 trade dress 訴訟企圖壟斷羊皮／羊毛內裡休閒鞋市場；2026-08 下旬聯邦法院駁回起訴書但准許修正。
findings.source: The Fashion Law: Quince's Antitrust Case Against UGG Owner Deckers Hits an Early Hurdle
findings.excerpt: Image : Quince key points Quince’s antitrust case against UGG owner Deckers has hit an early hurdle, with a court dismissing the complaint with leave to amend. Quince alleges that Deckers has used unprotectable trade dress rights to restrict competition in the footwear market.
